value.body: Site engineers supervise construction on site so the work follows drawings, schedule, quality and safety rules. They work for contractors, builders and infrastructure companies, and the day is spent on site checking work, coordinating with supervisors and subcontractors, measuring quantities and keeping records.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Tech / B.E. or diploma in Civil Engineering

items.label: Common tools
items.value: AutoCAD, MS Excel, total station / levelling instrument, project schedules

items.label: Civil engineering UG students
items.source: AISHE 2023-24 (Ministry of Education), institutions that reported

items.label: National highways built
items.source: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join contractors or builders as graduate or trainee engineers on a project, often through campus or direct hiring. Postings are where the project is, so relocation is common.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Quality checks on concrete, steel and materials

value.title: At a glance
items: Work is outdoors and often in remote locations.
Common next steps: project engineer, project manager, planning or quantity surveying roles.
Some graduates later take GATE for PSU or M.Tech routes.
